common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

language.title: Choose your language
language.spoken: Welcome to AfyaConnect. To continue in English, choose English.
language.spokenSw: Karibu AfyaConnect. Kuendelea kwa Kiswahili, chagua Kiswahili.
language.hint: Your choice sets the language of the whole app, including spoken guidance.

auth.spoken: Sign in to AfyaConnect. Enter your phone number and password, or switch to create a new account.
auth.name: Full name
auth.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.errorPassword: Password must be at least 4 characters.
auth.errorFailed: Sign in failed. Check your details and try again.

access.title: How do you use your phone?
access.spoken: Let us set up AfyaConnect for the way you use your phone. Options will be read aloud and highlighted one at a time. Wait for the option you want, then select it.
access.hint: You can change this any time in Settings.
access.voiceDesc: I speak to control the app
access.eye_trackingDesc: I look at buttons to choose
access.head_mouseDesc: I move a pointer with my head
access.switchDesc: I use one button to choose
access.saved: Your setup is saved. Welcome to AfyaConnect.

home.spoken: You are on the home screen. You can report symptoms, check your queue, see appointments, or get emergency help.
home.spokenVoice: Home. Say: report symptoms, my queue, appointments, or emergency. What would you like to do?
home.reportSymptomsHint: Tell us how you feel so we can help
home.caregiverHint: Act on behalf of a patient you support
home.notUnderstood: I did not understand that. Try: report symptoms, my queue, or emergency.

symptom.title: How are you feeling?
symptom.spoken: Report your symptoms. Pick from the common symptoms below, or describe how you feel. Serious symptoms are marked with a red border.
symptom.painLevelHint: Zero is no pain, ten is the worst pain
symptom.chooseOne: Choose a symptom or describe how you feel before sending.

triage.title: Your result
triage.joinQueueHint: Take your place in line to see a nurse

action.hospital_or_home_visit: You need urgent care — a hospital visit or a home visit nurse.
action.home_visit_priority: We'll prioritise a home visit nurse for you.
action.teleconsult_or_scheduled_visit: Book a video consultation or a clinic visit.
action.teleconsult_priority: We recommend a video consultation to avoid travel.
action.hospital_or_teleconsult: You need care soon — a hospital visit or a video consultation.
action.self_care_with_follow_up: Manage this at home and follow up if it doesn't improve.

triage.booked: Appointment booked. You can see it under Appointments.
triage.bookFailed: Could not book the appointment. Please try again.
triage.bookNeedsCaregiverPermission: This caregiver is not authorized to schedule appointments for this patient.

queue.title: Your queue
queue.spoken: You are in the queue. Your position and estimated wait are shown and read aloud as they change.
queue.youAreNext: You are next. Please be ready.
queue.teleconsultBody: Your wait is long. You can see a doctor by video now instead of waiting.
queue.teleconsultAccepted: Video consultation accepted. You will get a link by SMS.

appointments.title: Your appointments
appointments.spoken: Your upcoming appointments. Each one can be joined or opened for details.
appointments.emptyBody: When you report symptoms, we can book a video call, hospital slot, or home visit for you.
appointments.joinHint: Open the video call for this appointment
appointments.detailsHint: See the full details of this appointment
appointments.mockNotice: Demo data — sample appointments shown here. Not connected to a real server right now.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.spokenPrompt: Emergency. Do you want to send an emergency alert? Select confirm to send, or cancel to go back.
emergency.confirmBody: We will alert your caregiver and the AfyaConnect care team right away.
emergency.sentBody: Your caregiver and the care team have been alerted. Stay calm.
emergency.spokenSent: Alert sent. Your caregiver and the care team have been notified. Stay calm, help is on the way.
emergency.openHint: Send an emergency alert to your caregiver and care team

caregiver.title: Caregiver mode
caregiver.spoken: Caregiver mode. You are about to act on behalf of a patient. Please confirm.
caregiver.confirmBody: Everything you do will be recorded in the patient's activity log.
caregiver.entered: Caregiver mode on. You are acting for {{name}}.
caregiver.cannotSchedule: This patient has not allowed caregivers to schedule appointments.
caregiver.cannotConsent: This patient has not allowed caregivers to give consent.
caregiver.canSchedule: You can schedule appointments for this patient.
caregiver.actionLogged: Action recorded in the activity log.
caregiver.mockNotice: Demo — caregiver actions are logged locally right now. Not connected to a real server.

settings.title: Settings
settings.spoken: Settings. Here you can change your language, how you use the app, text size, scan speed, contrast, and sign out.
settings.scanSpeedHint: How long each item stays highlighted
settings.dwellTimeHint: How long to hold before selecting

profile.title: My profile
profile.spoken: Your profile. Your personal, medical, and caregiver details. Select edit to change them.
profile.name: Name

a11y.scannerOffScreenReader: Screen reader detected. Auto-scanning is off so it does not conflict with your screen reader.
a11y.sttUnavailable: Speech to text needs the full app version. Please type your symptoms instead.
